;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**Officials in [[Takhar Province]], [[Afghanistan]], report that 12 civilians, 11 of them children, were killed by an [[airstrike]] on a [[madrasa]]. The [[government of Afghanistan|central government]] says it killed 12 [[Taliban]] fighters. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-54597862 (BBC News)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**The [[Sunni Islam|Sunni Muslim]] [[Grand Mufti]] of [[Damascus]] Sheikh Mohammed Adnan Afiouni is [[assassinate]]d in a [[car bomb]]ing in the [[Syria]]n capital, according to state media. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-syria-security-cleric/damascus-cleric-killed-in-car-bomb-state-media-idUKKBN2772T4 (Reuters)]
*[[Terrorism in France]]
**[[National Police (France)|French police]] launch a terror investigation into a [[racism in France|racist]] attack on Sunday, in which two [[Islam in France|Muslim]] women were repeatedly stabbed near the [[Eiffel Tower]] while the perpetrators, believed to be two other women, shouted racial slurs at the victims. The attack came as tensions mount over the [[murder of Samuel Paty]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/10/22/two-women-stabbed-under-eiffel-tower-in-apparent-racist-attack (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.euroweeklynews.com/2020/10/21/two-muslim-women-stabbed-under-the-eiffel-tower-in-racist-attack/ (''Euro Weekly News'')] [https://www.nationalturk.com/en/muslim-women-suffer-knife-attack-near-eiffel-tower (''National Turk'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[The Palm Fountain]] in [[Palm Jumeirah]] opens to the public in [[Dubai]] and breaks the [[Guinness World Records]] for the world's largest [[fountain]] display. [https://www.khaleejtimes.com/uae/video-dubai-breaks-world-record-for-largest-fountain (''Khaleej Times'')]

;Health and environment 
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Illinois]]
*****[[Mayor of Chicago|Chicago Mayor]] [[Lori Lightfoot]] announces a new restrictions banning indoor service for bars without a food license and impose non-essential business curfew between 10 p.m. and 6 a.m. [[Central Time Zone|CT]] for two weeks from tomorrow. In addition, all liquor sales at all establishments must end at 9 p.m. and all Chicagoans should refrain from gatherings of more than six people or any social gatherings after 10 p.m. [https://www.chicagotribune.com/coronavirus/ct-coronavirus-chicago-lightfoot-arwady-news-conference-20201022-2i5htmjrrrbolc2jp4gw5lu5va-story.html (''Chicago Tribune'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hawaii]]
*****Hawaii registers 14 additional [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] fatalities, which have now pushed the state's death toll to 203. [https://www.hawaiinewsnow.com/2020/10/21/death-toll-covid-hawaii-surpasses-additional-fatalities-are-added/ (Hawaii News Now)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Jersey]]
*****[[Governor of New Jersey|Governor]] [[Phil Murphy]] goes into [[quarantine]] after two of his staffers tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/local/nj-gov-phil-murphy-self-quarantines-after-exposure-to-covid-positive-person/2680354/ (WNBC)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington (state)]]
*****[[Governor of Washington (state)|Governor]] [[Jay Inslee]] announces that the state's COVID-19 cases have officially surpassed 100,000. [https://dailyhive.com/seattle/washington-state-100000-coronavirus-cases-october (''Daily Hive'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
*****[[Michigan]] reports 43 new deaths, its highest single-day total since May 30. [https://www.abc12.com/2020/10/22/michigan-reports-fourth-highest-daily-increase-in-covid-19-cases-most-deaths-since-may/ (WJRT-TV)]
****The [[Food and Drug Administration]] approves [[remdesivir]] to treat COVID-19 in hospitalized patients. The drug, manufactured by the pharmaceutical company [[Gilead_Sciences|Gilead]] under the brand name [[Veklury]], is the first fully approved COVID-19 treatment in the [[United States]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-54654635 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Alberta]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
*****It is announced that the [[Government of Canada|Canadian government]] and [[Alberta]] are launching a pilot program to test eligible returning travelers for COVID-19, allowing them to leave quarantine in two days once they receive a negative result instead of a normal two-week quarantine. The move could potentially bring relief to the country's struggling airline and tourism industries. Starting November 2, the new testing option will be offered at the [[Sweetgrass–Coutts Border Crossing|Coutts land border crossing]] in southern Alberta and [[Calgary International Airport]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/calgary/alberta-covid-19-test-border-pilot-1.5772637 (CBC)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[Prime Minister of France|Prime Minister]] [[Jean Castex]] announces that 38 more [[Departments of France|departments]], as well as [[French Polynesia]], will be placed under curfew starting October 24. In total, 54 departments will now adhere to the new hourly limitations between 9:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m. local time, affecting almost 46 million people in these areas. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-54646533 (BBC News)]
****The number of new confirmed cases in [[France]] hits an alarming record high of 41,622 in the last 24 hours, making it the first time the country has reported more than 40,000 new cases. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/covid-19-france-sees-alarming-rise-of-41-622-new-cases/2015820 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****The number of new confirmed cases in [[Greece]] hits a record high of 882 in the past 24 hours, making it the highest number in a single day since the pandemic began, bringing the cumulative total to 28,216. [https://greece.greekreporter.com/2020/10/22/new-record-882-covid-cases-15-deaths-in-greece-on-thursday/ (Greek Reporter)]
****[[Prime Minister of Greece|Prime Minister]] [[Kyriakos Mitsotakis]] announces new measures to curb the spread of COVID-19. These measures include the "compulsory" use of masks both indoors and outdoors and imposition of a curfew between 12:30 a.m. and 5:00 a.m. local time in all areas deemed as high-risk zones, including [[Athens]] and [[Thessaloniki]], starting October 24. [https://medicalxpress.com/news/2020-10-greek-pm-declares-virus-curfew.html (Medical Xpress)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports a record daily increase with 3,270 new cases, bringing the cumulative counts to 109,541 confirmed cases and 2,245 deaths. [https://covid19.min-saude.pt/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/234_DGS_boletim_20201022.pdf (DGS)]
****Portugal announces that tomorrow, the municipalities of [[Felgueiras]], [[Lousada]], and [[Paços de Ferreira]] will go into a partial [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]], which means that people will only be able to leave home for work, school, or other essential activities. In addition, visits to care homes will be banned, events can only be attended by a maximum of five people, and commercial outlets must close by 10:00 p.m. local time. [https://nationalpost.com/pmn/health-pmn/portugal-imposes-partial-lockdown-on-three-northern-municipalities-2  (''National Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****The number of new confirmed cases in [[Austria]] surges to a record 2,435 in the past 24 hours, making it the highest single-day increase since the [[pandemic]] began. [https://m.hindustantimes.com/world-news/austria-s-daily-covid-19-tally-rises-to-new-high-of-2-435-report/story-X1spD6R7fJvm3oX6J2V2KI.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium]]
****[[Belgium|Belgian]] incumbent [[List of Foreign Ministers of Belgium|Foreign Minister]] and former [[Prime Minister of Belgium|Prime Minister]] [[Sophie Wilmès]] is admitted to an [[intensive care unit]] nearly a week after testing positive for COVID-19. [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-belgiums-foreign-minister-and-former-prime-minister-sophie-wilmes-in-intensive-care-12111034 (Sky News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus]]
****[[List of Ministers of Health of the Republic of Cyprus|Minister of Health]] Constantinos Ioannou announces the imposing of a curfew in [[Limassol District|Limassol]] and [[Paphos District|Paphos]] districts and a mask mandate for all outdoor spaces. [https://cyprus-mail.com/2020/10/22/coronavirus-masks-to-be-worn-outside-curfew-in-paphos-and-limassol/ (''Cyprus-Mail'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****For the first time since the beginning of the pandemic, [[Germany]] has recorded more than 10,000 [[COVID-19]] cases in a single day, when the [[Robert Koch Institute]] reported 11,287 new infections in 24 hours. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20201022-germany-reports-record-new-virus-cases-in-24-hours (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports a record high in new infections, topping 16,000 daily cases for the first time since the start of the pandemic. According to data from the [[Ministry of Health (Italy)|Health Ministry]], the nationwide total has reached 465,726 cases. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/italy-sets-new-record-in-daily-coronavirus-cases-with-over-16000-new-infections (''Daily Sabah'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovakia]]
****[[Prime Minister of Slovakia|Prime Minister]] [[Igor Matovič]] announces that Slovakia will shut down most of its schools and require the population to stay home apart from work, essential shopping, and nature trips between October 24 and November 1, in an attempt to curb the spread of COVID-19. He also plans to go ahead with nationwide free testing of 5.5 million people across the country. [https://news.yahoo.com/slovakia-orders-partial-lockdown-saturday-175314875.html (Yahoo News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****The [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Health Ministry]] reports a record high of 20,986 new cases in Spain in the last 24 hours and put the cumulative 14-day incidence rate at 349 infections per 100,000 inhabitants. [https://english.elpais.com/society/2020-10-23/coronavirus-cases-continue-to-rise-in-spain-with-nearly-21000-reported-in-one-day.html (''El Pais'' in English)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in West Bengal]]
****On the first day of [[Durga Puja]], West Bengal records its highest single-day spike of 4,157 new cases in the past 24 hours as doctors warn that the number could rise massively given a large number of gatherings in markets, shopping malls, and restaurants. [https://www.theweek.in/news/india/2020/10/22/daily-covid-19-cases-in-west-bengal-hit-record-on-first-day-of-durga-puja.html (''The Week'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco]]
***[[Morocco]]'s Ministry of Health reports 4,151 new cases in the past 24 hours. This is the highest number of reported infections in a single day, bringing the total number of confirmed infections to 186,731. [https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2020/10/323385/morocco-confirms-record-breaking-4151-new-covid-19-cases-in-24-hours/ (''Morocco World News'')]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Moderna]] announces that they have fully enrolled their trial, with around 30,000 participants. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/health/2020/10/22/vaccine-trial-moderna/ (''The Washington Post'')]

;International relations
*[[Taiwan–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Department of State]] approves a [[United States dollar|$]]1.8 billion [[List of US arms sales to Taiwan|weapon sales]] deal with [[Taiwan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/10/21/us-state-dept-approves-1-8bn-in-potential-arms-sales-to-taiwan (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Iran–United States relations]], [[Iran–Iraq relations]], [[Iranian intervention in Iraq (2014–present)|Iranian intervention in Iraq]]
**The [[United States Department of the Treasury|U.S. Department of the Treasury]] says it has [[Sanctions against Iran|blacklisted]] [[Iraj Masjedi]], the [[Iran]]ian Ambassador to [[Iraq]], saying he has overseen the training and support of Shia militia groups, which are responsible for attacks on U.S. and coalition forces in Iraq. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-usa-iran-sanctions/u-s-says-it-blacklisted-irans-ambassador-to-iraq-idUKKBN27732L (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Killing of George Floyd]]
**A [[Hennepin County, Minnesota]] judge drops the [[third-degree murder]] charge against former [[Minneapolis Police Department|Minneapolis Police]] officer [[Derek Chauvin]], who was filmed kneeling on the neck of [[George Floyd]] for nearly nine minutes in May. He still faces second-degree murder and [[manslaughter]] charges. [https://www.npr.org/sections/live-updates-protests-for-racial-justice/2020/10/22/926627083/judge-drops-a-murder-charge-against-former-officer-who-kneeled-on-george-floyds- (NPR)]
*[[2020 Thai protests]]
**[[Thailand]]'s [[Prime Minister of Thailand|Prime Minister]] [[Prayut Chan-o-cha]] lifts the "severe" [[state of emergency]] that was imposed in [[Bangkok]] to crack down on the protesters. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/10/22/asia/thailand-protests-state-of-emergency-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*Authorities announce the May arrest of a 19-year-old man from [[Kannapolis, North Carolina]], who had allegedly been plotting to kill [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] presidential nominee [[Joe Biden]], after police towed his van and recovered firearms and explosives from it. He is being charged with possession of [[child pornography]] in relation to video and images later found in his electronic devices. [https://abc11.com/man-accused-of-plotting-to-kill-biden;-van-with-guns-found-in-nc/7253661/ (WTVD)] [https://myfox8.com/your-local-election-hq/man-who-researched-killing-joe-biden-arrested-in-nc-with-van-full-of-explosives-guns-child-pornography-court-documents-say/ (WGHP)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Guinean presidential election]]
**Preliminary results show [[Alpha Condé]] winning [[Guinea]]'s latest [[Elections in Guinea|presidential election]]. The announcement sparks violent protests in the capital [[Conakry]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/guinea-president-alpha-conde-poised-for-landslide-election-win/a-55366419 (DW)]
*[[2020 Seychellois parliamentary election]]; [[2020 Seychellois presidential election]]
**[[Elections in Seychelles|Presidential and parliamentary elections]] are being simultaneously held in [[Seychelles]]. Voting is scheduled to last until October 24. [http://www.seychellesnewsagency.com/articles/13744/First+votes+cast+in+Seychelles%27+-day+presidential%2C+National+Assembly+election (Seychelles News Agency)]
*[[Vote of no confidence in the government of Pedro Sánchez]]
**[[Prime Minister of Spain|Prime Minister]] [[Pedro Sánchez]] survives a [[vote of no-confidence]] presented by the [[far-right]] [[Vox (political party)|Vox]] [[Party politics|political party]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/spain-lawmakers-set-reject-confidence-motion-73756810 (ABC News)]
*[[2020 United States presidential debates]]
**[[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] and former [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Joe Biden]] meet for the final debate before the [[2020 United States presidential election|election]] next month. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2020/10/22/us/presidential-debate-live?action=click&module=Spotlight&pgtype=Homepage (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Saad Hariri]] is designated as [[Prime Minister of Lebanon]], tasked with forming his fourth government, by a slim majority of the [[Parliament of Lebanon|Chamber of Deputies]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/10/22/lebanons-saad-hariri-secures-parliamentary-support-to-be-next-pm (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Abortion in Poland]]
**The [[Constitutional Tribunal (Poland)|Constitutional Tribunal]] of [[Poland]] rules that [[abortion]]s in cases of [[fetal defect]]s are unconstitutional. Once the decision comes into effect, terminations will only be allowed in cases of rape or incest, or if the mother's health is at risk. Poland's abortion laws were already among the strictest in Europe. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-54642108 (BBC News)]
